images.title: Image A grows to image D by one factor
images.purpose: Shows that both the width and the height of image A are multiplied by 3/2 to give image D, so the change is proportional.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two plain rectangles side by side, the smaller on the left, with matching factor arrows for width and height.
images.exact_structure: Left: one teal (#0072B2) outlined rectangle 60 units wide and 40 units high, its width marked 60 mm under it and its height marked 40 mm at its left side. Right: one amber (#E69F00) outlined rectangle 90 units wide and 60 units high, bottoms aligned with the left rectangle, its width marked 90 mm under it and its height marked 60 mm at its right side. Exactly two reddish purple (#CC79A7) arrows go from left to right: one across the top from the top edge of the small rectangle to the top edge of the large one, labelled × 3/2, and one lower down between the two rectangles, also labelled × 3/2. The word proportional sits centred below both rectangles. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Width and height both changed by the factor 3/2, so the change is proportional.
images.description: Shows that both the width and the height of image A are multiplied by 3/2 to give image D, so the change is proportional.

image_decisions.why: Seeing the same factor on both sides makes the meaning of proportional concrete.
